subject_areas.name: Subject Areas
subject_areas.description: Represents the highest level of business categorization within the organization, such as Human Resources, Finance, Sales, or Manufacturing.
subject_areas.purpose: Provides a logical grouping for rules, datasets, and business processes within the Data Catalog.
key_points: Every Rule must belong to a Subject Area.
Every Business Process must belong to a Subject Area.
Used for organizing Data Catalog assets.

business_processes.name: Business Processes
business_processes.description: Represents an operational business function where data quality is measured.
business_processes.purpose: Groups rules around a specific business activity to calculate quality metrics.
key_points: Rules are assigned to Business Processes.
Quality metrics are calculated from associated Rules.

datasets.name: Datasets
datasets.description: A logical collection of fields associated with one or more system datastores.
datasets.purpose: Maps business documentation and governance assets to physical data storage.
key_points: Can represent only a subset of datastore fields.

rules.name: Rules
rules.description: Defines business data requirements that establish the foundation for data quality.
rules.purpose: Specifies the expected business condition that data must satisfy.
key_points: Can belong to multiple Business Processes.
Can belong to multiple Business Concepts.

business_concepts.name: Business Concepts
business_concepts.description: Represents a business entity or concept used throughout the enterprise.
business_concepts.purpose: Creates relationships between datasets, business processes, and governance assets.

enforcements.name: Enforcements
enforcements.description: Defines how a Rule is validated against a specific system and business objective.
enforcements.purpose: Specifies implementation requirements, target system, and enforcement objective.

implementations.name: Implementations
implementations.description: Contains the executable technical logic that validates data against a Rule.
implementations.purpose: Implements business requirements using SQL or other technical code.

opportunity_query.name: Opportunity Query
opportunity_query.description: Defines the total number of records that are eligible for validation.
opportunity_query.purpose: Provides the denominator for quality score calculations.
key_points: Used to calculate Data Quality scores.

error_query.name: Error Query
error_query.description: Returns only the records that violate a Rule.
key_points: Must always be a subset of the Opportunity Query.
examples: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL
